children: Dauch’s third-quarter net sales rose year over year, driven primarily by the Dowlais acquisition, while net loss replaced prior-year income. Higher interest expense, restructuring and acquisition-related costs, and foreign-exchange and derivative effects weighed on results.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss) attributable to Dauch”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings (loss) per share”.
: The February Dowlais combination contributed approximately $1.39 billion to third-quarter net sales.
: Segment Adjusted EBITDA increased to $263.9 million from $163.3 million, reflecting the Business Combination.
: Segment Adjusted EBITDA rose to $94.6 million from $32.4 million, reflecting the Business Combination and improved operating performance, partly offset by lower volumes.
: Gross margin was 9.7%, compared with 12.6% a year earlier; material costs were approximately 51% of cost of goods sold versus 54%.
